country_options_basis.basis: Exact existing user-interface option inventory; English display names are generated by the current Intl.DisplayNames implementation. It is not a sovereignty determination, sanctioned-country list or approved-market list.

review_rule: Every country/activity needs a current verified human assessment and actual evidence. No completed country approval or approval receipt workflow is implemented. The backend blocks paid checkout for every non-US order, including scoped orders; international intake/scope review remains available. US consulting checkout is an existing request route, not whole-country enterprise clearance. Public JSON cannot authorize live execution.
transaction_rule: Review relevant parties, ownership, activity, end users, end use and current sanctions/export requirements separately for each transaction; do not infer permission from a country code.
publication_status: MAINTAINED_SOURCE_PREPARED; live deployment and installed artifact verification tracked separately by release receipts.
